_comment: New deposits of row il-47. The Law as enacted (Sefer HaChukim 1522) is the existing file ../amending-laws/13_lsr_203774.pdf (sha256 873f9bf4ff699d5f7d79ff083fd9850c4aa06b24ecaa06429ed5cd5a35ea976d, 4596653 bytes), recomputed on 2026-11-10; its pages 299 and 301 were read from page images rendered into img/ here. ALL PDFs here are page extracts: only the pages the row reads from are deposited; the whole files are not in the bundle, and their URL, sha256 and size as downloaded are in whole_files_not_deposited and in the whole_file field of each extract.
